chapter: Le Ruban Bleu, retirement and community work
title: The Three Deuces with Fats Waller and her accompanists
summary: She sang at the Three Deuces with Fats Waller accompanying her and gets comic songs from working with Fats.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh sure. It was during that time also I made those albums with Ellis Larkins
Yeah, that was in '47.
Yes.
Yeah, that's another good group which we talked about.
Yes.
Okay, so your next major kind of residency was at the Village Vanguard then?
Yes.

52nd Street again at the Three Dueces. That's one of the clubs I have listed.

Yeah, I think I went in there with Fats Waller for a spell, for about a two-week or a four-week engagement. Yeah, I remember that. I think Fats had just come back from Europe or something like that. He had Una Mae Carlisle with him, the singer.
Yes.
He was to sing at the band and I was feature.
And Fats was accompanying you? How terrific!
Yes. I've been very fortunate in getting good background music. This is what I mean by being restricted to arrangements, you know. If you got a small group behind you you can supervise more.
And I presume you can exploit the particular qualities that each of them had.
That's right.
Did you get into some comedies?
Well, you throw in a few, you know, anybody who works with Fats has got to be in the act, you know. And you know, this back and forth
